{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, identify QA orders: they are '999,999.99' (with comma)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()

# Refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()

# Apply filters: exclude QA and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Verify the data dictionary: there are six QA orders
assert num_qa == 6, f'Expected 6 QA orders, found {num_qa}'

# Compute conversion rate on filtered data
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print all required evidence
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')
print(f'Final population size: {len(filtered_df)}')
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')"}
